title: Do I need car insurance if my car is off the road?
description:
If you own a car you don't want to drive, you'll need to legally declare it 'off road'. You can do this with a Statutory Off Road Notification (SORN).

Once that's done, you don't need car insurance for it! If you want to drive it again, you'll need to let the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) know and insure it again.

Check out our more in-depth guide on SORN and what it means.
